posts.text:
Artificial Analysis ranks frontier models by how well they drive a robot arm

Its AA-Robotics v0.1 preview gives each model a six-axis arm and four cameras, and the top score is 69 for GPT-6 Astra, at about 30 minutes a task.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-aa-robotics-v01/

Fish Audio's Drama 3 voice model now runs in vLLM-Omni

The 35-billion-parameter speech model activates 3 billion per token and speaks 83 languages, its model card says, and vLLM reports 255 ms to first audio.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-fish-audio-drama-3/

Player-1 agents learn to play games from 16 synthetic worlds

Two Qwen3.5-based models rose from 10.5% to 38.3% on a Minecraft test after reinforcement learning, the paper's authors say, and also played Doom.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-player-1-game-agents/

TSMC guides fourth-quarter revenue up to $54.3 billion

The chipmaker's results page shows $46.72 billion in third-quarter revenue against a $44.6 billion to $45.8 billion forecast, with a $52.3 billion to $54.3 billion range for the next quarter.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-tsmc-q3-ai-guidance/

Figma lets teams write design rules in Markdown for AI agents

Figma Specs is a Markdown editor for design rules, and the company's code layers feature enters public beta, TechCrunch reported from Figma's first Config event in India.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-figma-config-india-agents/

Musk says SpaceX will repay Grok Bot users for errors

Elon Musk posted that SpaceX will "make you whole" if Grok Bot botches a purchase or leaks a card, adding it has never happened. No written policy backs the pledge.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-grok-bot-make-you-whole/

OpenAI agrees to stop using alleged Apple trade secrets in lawsuit

At a hearing, OpenAI agreed not to use material Apple says was stolen and to image the devices of 14 employees, and the judge called an injunction for Apple likely.

https://theaipost.net/story/c383ee815/

Vals AI says no model reached 2 out of 100 on its humanoid tasks

In real-time MuJoCo simulations, Vals says GPT-6.1 Sol averaged 51 on 13 robot-arm tasks, while the 11 humanoid tasks, which need balance and walking, stayed near zero.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-vals-robotics-sim/

Anthropic tells investors third-quarter revenue reached $16.8 billion

Bloomberg reports the figure, up from about $11.6 billion in the second quarter, went to prospective investors as the company pushes ahead with plans to go public.

https://theaipost.net/story/cb0c59de3/

Nvidia says tuning lifted a chip-design agent's score from 55% to 95%

In a case study with Siemens' Fuse EDA agent, Nvidia says better skills and tool descriptions cut agent turns by two thirds, using Claude Opus 4.8 in Claude Code.

https://theaipost.net/story/cac584057/

vLLM adaptive verification now works with draft models lacking a confidence head

A new estimator learns acceptance odds while serving, so EAGLE, MTP and DFlash checkpoints can use the feature with no retraining, the vLLM team says.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-vllm-adaptive-verification/
